join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set displayWarnings on
send_any


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Filters are now enabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter me on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Me filter is now enabled.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter exempt
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Filter exempt level is set to subscribers.


handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 chatter-display=Random :this is a normal message
no_send


handle_me hortbot foobar/1 random/2 message-id=f5b6adc3-e741-4661-b1e7-93372ef10098 chatter-display=Random access=subscriber :hehe
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter exempt broadcaster
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Invalid level.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter exempt nobody
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Invalid level.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter exempt moderators
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Filter exempt level set to moderators.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter exempt moderators
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Filter exempt level is already set to moderators.


twitch_delete_chat_message {"BroadcasterID": 1, "ModID": 999, "Tok": {"access_token": "some-access-token", "token_type": "bearer", "refresh_token": "some-refresh-token", "expiry": "2050-10-01T03:11:00Z"}, "ID": "a37ae19a-1227-4b72-8c6b-94379287b927"}
handle_me hortbot foobar/1 random/2 message-id=a37ae19a-1227-4b72-8c6b-94379287b927 chatter-display=Random access=subscriber :hehe
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Random, "/me" is not allowed in this channel - warning


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter exempt vips
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Filter exempt level set to vips.

handle_me hortbot foobar/1 random3/3 chatter-display=Random3 access=vip :hehe
no_send

twitch_delete_chat_message {"BroadcasterID": 1, "ModID": 999, "Tok": {"access_token": "some-access-token", "token_type": "bearer", "refresh_token": "some-refresh-token", "expiry": "2050-10-01T03:11:00Z"}, "ID": "4c8efc42-cab6-4289-9d8f-aa63c5dda349"}
handle_me hortbot foobar/1 random3/3 message-id=4c8efc42-cab6-4289-9d8f-aa63c5dda349 chatter-display=Random3 access=subscriber :hehe
